lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: You set out two cups before I arrived.

lines.speaker: oren
lines.text: You make the same circuit every night. I was beginning to worry about the tea.

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: I came to ask whether I gave the right orders.

lines.speaker: oren
lines.text: Sit down first. You are allowed to be thirsty before you are a commander.

lines.speaker: oren
lines.text: There is no Oren on your list of people to repay.

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: You said you needed nothing.

lines.speaker: oren
lines.text: I said my roof did not leak. Those are different things.

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: Then tell me what to write.

lines.speaker: oren
lines.text: A morning when you let someone else carry the banner.

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: I can promise you tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: When this ends, will you stand guard again?

lines.speaker: oren
lines.text: At the workshop, perhaps. To keep the rain out.

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: I was hoping you would help me with the meeting hall.

lines.speaker: oren
lines.text: Does it need a guard?

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: Someone who knows when to leave the door open.

lines.speaker: oren
lines.text: Then I will bring the spare cup.

lines.speaker: ivo
lines.text: What does the little blue cup mean?

lines.speaker: sera
lines.text: Clean water. The pie is marked with a triangle.

lines.speaker: ivo
lines.text: Your water marks could save my patients a day of travel.

lines.speaker: sera
lines.text: Then take this copy. I can remember where the pie is.

lines.speaker: sera
lines.text: I found a shorter route to the infirmary.

lines.speaker: ivo
lines.text: How steep?

lines.speaker: sera
lines.text: Steep enough that I should have asked before calling it shorter.

lines.speaker: ivo
lines.text: Distance looks different from a stretcher.

lines.speaker: sera
lines.text: Come with me tomorrow. We will draw that version too.

lines.speaker: ivo
lines.text: Bring the pencil with the broad point. My hands shake after a long shift.

lines.speaker: ivo
lines.text: Your new atlas has a very large margin.

lines.speaker: sera
lines.text: Beds, wells, people who will open a door after dark. I needed the space.

lines.speaker: ivo
lines.text: You cannot promise every traveler a welcome.

lines.speaker: sera
lines.text: No. But I can make it easier for a welcome to be found.

lines.speaker: ivo
lines.text: Put my name beside the first infirmary.

lines.speaker: sera
lines.text: Already there. Beside a blue cup.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: That is the worst river chart I have ever seen.

lines.speaker: tarin
lines.text: It is a diagram of the night sky.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Explains why I could not find the toll station.

lines.speaker: tarin
lines.text: If the sky acquires one, I will draw you a better chart.

lines.speaker: tarin
lines.text: Your boat sits lower than your cargo list predicts.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: The list forgets the medicine under the grain.

lines.speaker: tarin
lines.text: You should include it. The current will not honor a discreet omission.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Then help me write two lists. One for the guards, one for the river.

lines.speaker: tarin
lines.text: I would rather the river receive the honest one.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Now you are learning my business.

lines.speaker: tarin
lines.text: I have calculated the safest load for your next vessel.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Good. Have you calculated its name?

lines.speaker: tarin
lines.text: That lies outside my field.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: The Question. You kept asking until somebody listened.

lines.speaker: tarin
lines.text: I am not sure I deserve a boat.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Then keep her from sinking. We can discuss deserving it afterward.

lines.speaker: nell
lines.text: You heard me coming?

lines.speaker: bram
lines.text: The buckle on your left boot clicks.

lines.speaker: nell
lines.text: I spent years learning to open doors quietly.

lines.speaker: bram
lines.text: Doors rarely have that many loose buckles.

lines.speaker: nell
lines.text: You fixed my boot without asking.

lines.speaker: bram
lines.text: The leather was splitting. I left the buckle loose in case you preferred it.

lines.speaker: nell
lines.text: Why would I prefer being heard?

lines.speaker: bram
lines.text: Sometimes it helps people know you are coming home.

lines.speaker: nell
lines.text: Leave a little click, then.

lines.speaker: bram
lines.text: A little click I can manage.

lines.speaker: nell
lines.text: I found a key that fits nothing.

lines.speaker: bram
lines.text: We could build something around it.

lines.speaker: nell
lines.text: That sounds like a ridiculous way to build a house.

lines.speaker: bram
lines.text: A workshop, perhaps. You could decide who gets copies.

lines.speaker: nell
lines.text: One for you. You will be doing most of the sensible work.

lines.speaker: bram
lines.text: And a bell. So neither of us has to sneak in.

lines.speaker: esme
lines.text: You have repaired that step twice.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: The first repair was poor.

lines.speaker: esme
lines.text: The second was finished an hour ago.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: I was not ready to come inside.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: I knew the woman whose name is in that verse.

lines.speaker: esme
lines.text: Then tell me something I do not know.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: She kept geese. They chased our captain out of her yard.

lines.speaker: esme
lines.text: That deserves a place beside her name.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: I thought you would want an apology.

lines.speaker: esme
lines.text: I want her remembered as more than what was done to her.

lines.speaker: esme
lines.text: The wall will need another pair of hands tomorrow.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: I will be here.

lines.speaker: esme
lines.text: I know. I was asking whether you would teach the children to lay the stones.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Are you certain they should learn from me?

lines.speaker: esme
lines.text: They should learn how a wall is made strong, and how a mistake is repaired.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: I can teach that. I am still learning it.

lines.speaker: cassian
lines.text: Your trail marker points away from the road.

lines.speaker: faye
lines.text: The road is flooded.

lines.speaker: cassian
lines.text: The official map does not show a stream there.

lines.speaker: faye
lines.text: You can explain that to the water while I find us a crossing.

lines.speaker: cassian
lines.text: I prepared a speech for the village council.

lines.speaker: faye
lines.text: They need their culvert cleared.

lines.speaker: cassian
lines.text: I can do both.

lines.speaker: faye
lines.text: Start with the culvert. You may find they have things to tell you.

lines.speaker: cassian
lines.text: Would you listen to the speech afterward?

lines.speaker: faye
lines.text: If you still think it answers their questions.

lines.speaker: cassian
lines.text: I threw away the speech.

lines.speaker: faye
lines.text: You could have used the back for notes.

lines.speaker: cassian
lines.text: I did. Three pages of them.

lines.speaker: faye
lines.text: And what did you learn?

lines.speaker: cassian
lines.text: Who repairs the bank when the river rises. I had never asked.

lines.speaker: faye
lines.text: Good. Next spring, ask where they need another shovel.

lines.speaker: vela
lines.text: You have checked everyone in this camp except yourself.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Someone has to check the newest arrivals.

lines.speaker: vela
lines.text: The lighthouse keeper counts as an arrival. She has brought two bowls.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: That is a remarkably specific regulation.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Could your light signal a storm to the far docks?

lines.speaker: vela
lines.text: If someone there knows the sequence.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Teach me. We lost two hands because a warning stopped at the foreman's office.

lines.speaker: vela
lines.text: Then we will teach more than one person.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Every shift. And the kitchen workers.

lines.speaker: vela
lines.text: Especially anyone who notices when a crew fails to return.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: The dock crews sent back your signal.

lines.speaker: vela
lines.text: All three shifts?

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: And the kitchen. They added a signal for hot supper.

lines.speaker: vela
lines.text: A valuable addition to maritime safety.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: You can come down from the tower tonight. They know the watch.

lines.speaker: vela
lines.text: Keep me a bowl. I would like to see their faces when they answer.

lines.speaker: una
lines.text: I chose the chair facing the door for you.

lines.speaker: silas
lines.text: That is either kindness or a very good interrogation technique.

lines.speaker: una
lines.text: Tonight it is kindness.

lines.speaker: silas
lines.text: I will try to accept the shorter explanation.

lines.speaker: silas
lines.text: You kept the clause they removed from the treaty.

lines.speaker: una
lines.text: It named the villages that would lose their wells.

lines.speaker: silas
lines.text: I have destroyed documents for less.

lines.speaker: una
lines.text: Why tell me that?

lines.speaker: silas
lines.text: Because I want you to know what I mean when I say I will keep this one safe.

lines.speaker: una
lines.text: Then let us make copies. Safety should not depend on one honest evening.

lines.speaker: silas
lines.text: I sat with my back to the door yesterday.

lines.speaker: una
lines.text: I noticed. I also noticed you moved the mirror.

lines.speaker: silas
lines.text: A modest victory, then.

lines.speaker: una
lines.text: A real one. You do not owe me a performance of trust.

lines.speaker: silas
lines.text: What do I owe you?

lines.speaker: una
lines.text: The truth when it is difficult. I will try to offer the same.

lines.speaker: petra
lines.text: Your bird has stolen my measuring string.

lines.speaker: ari
lines.text: Rain considers all string a preliminary nest.

lines.speaker: petra
lines.text: It was supporting a model bridge.

lines.speaker: ari
lines.text: Then she has discovered a serious design weakness.

lines.speaker: petra
lines.text: I added a perch to the signal tower plan.

lines.speaker: ari
lines.text: Rain prefers a clear approach from the east.

lines.speaker: petra
lines.text: I was designing for messengers, not her preferences.

lines.speaker: ari
lines.text: She is the messenger.

lines.speaker: petra
lines.text: Then ask her about the crosswind before I set the height.

lines.speaker: ari
lines.text: I will take her up. She is more persuasive in person.

lines.speaker: ari
lines.text: The tower held three birds, two children, and an anxious mayor.

lines.speaker: petra
lines.text: I allowed for four children.

lines.speaker: ari
lines.text: You did not mention that in the plan.

lines.speaker: petra
lines.text: People climb things. A useful structure survives being used.

lines.speaker: ari
lines.text: I will put that on the plaque.

lines.speaker: petra
lines.text: Put the maintenance instructions there instead. We can argue about wisdom later.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: How long has this soil been warm?

lines.speaker: galen
lines.text: Long enough for the roots to wake. Too soon for the leaves.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: I need a sample from each bed.

lines.speaker: galen
lines.text: Take the radishes too. They have made their objections quite plain.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: I cannot promise the gardens will survive the shutdown.

lines.speaker: galen
lines.text: I asked for a forecast, not a promise.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: The eastern beds have the best chance.

lines.speaker: galen
lines.text: Then that is where the cuttings go.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: You do not seem surprised.

lines.speaker: galen
lines.text: I have planted through several rulers. Hope benefits from a second seed tray.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: The cuttings have new leaves.

lines.speaker: galen
lines.text: Three of them. The fourth may yet surprise us.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: I recorded your name beside the observation.

lines.speaker: galen
lines.text: Record who carried the water too.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: I did. There was barely room on the page.

lines.speaker: galen
lines.text: A good problem. Leave another page for what grows next.

lines.speaker: yuna
lines.text: Why do you tap every beam?

lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: A ceiling tells you when it is tired. Quietly, at first.

lines.speaker: yuna
lines.text: The palace taught me something similar about footsteps.

lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: Then keep listening below while I listen above.

lines.speaker: yuna
lines.text: That passage has patrols every forty breaths.

lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: And a cracked support at the turn. We cannot rush everyone through.

lines.speaker: yuna
lines.text: I can give us another forty.

lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: How?

lines.speaker: yuna
lines.text: By being seen exactly where they expect a dancer to be.

lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: Only if you tell me where you will come back out.

lines.speaker: yuna
lines.text: No one told me where to stand this morning.

lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: Did you find somewhere?

lines.speaker: yuna
lines.text: In the sun. For a while, that was enough.

lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: My children used to ask why I kept my helmet on outside.

lines.speaker: yuna
lines.text: What will you tell them now?

lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: That I am learning to look up without being afraid of what is above me.

lines.speaker: rhea
lines.text: You have polished the same buckle for ten minutes.

lines.speaker: elian
lines.text: You have folded that letter six times.

lines.speaker: rhea
lines.text: It still says too little.

lines.speaker: elian
lines.text: Mine shines too much. Neither task is improving with repetition.

lines.speaker: rhea
lines.text: Did you ever tell him an order was wrong?

lines.speaker: elian
lines.text: Sometimes. More often I tried to make it less wrong.

lines.speaker: rhea
lines.text: I keep removing the angry lines from my letter.

lines.speaker: elian
lines.text: Does that leave anything true?

lines.speaker: rhea
lines.text: It leaves something easier for him to read.

lines.speaker: elian
lines.text: Then perhaps one angry line should stay.

lines.speaker: rhea
lines.text: I sent it.

lines.speaker: elian
lines.text: Would you like me to ask whether it arrived?

lines.speaker: rhea
lines.text: Yes. But do not ask anyone to pretend he answered.

lines.speaker: elian
lines.text: I will bring you what I learn.

lines.speaker: rhea
lines.text: Whatever he chooses, the surrender road must stay open.

lines.speaker: elian
lines.text: It will. And you will not have to stand at the gate alone.
